title: pack
description: <pack-dir>/standards.json — a standards pack's own manifest: sections (guidance) and checks (tool runs) a pack contributes at the org, team or repo layer. Not a ticket handoff artifact; registered alongside the sixteen that are so `ai-flow schema pack` and internal/schema stay the one canonical listing of every JSON shape in the system. internal/standards.Validate layers cross-referencing rules (check_runner_missing, path existence) on top of this schema's shape check.

overrides.description: Declares, with a reason, every less-specific `must` section or check id this pack replaces. Only meaningful in a more specific layer's manifest (a repository's own pack replacing a team or org entry, a team's replacing an org one): without a declaration here the less specific entry wins and the conflict is reported at resolve time. Replacing a `should` or a `may` needs no declaration.

tool.description: The external binary this check runs. Absent for a built-in runner — the spec's Checks table documents `dependency`, `layout`, `docs`, `commit` and `pr` as built-in (its own manifest example has `{ "id": "commit.conventional", "kind": "commit", "severity": "must" }` with no tool at all), and a check with no tool has no allowlist row to be missing.
